scientific_integrity: The full fixed-dimension theorem is supported by the analytic energy argument and Bessel asymptotics. The included numerical checkers are reproducibility tests, not an infinite proof or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: All density and parity limits keep ambient dimension fixed; the planar stationary-point census is earlier work. Neither uniformity in dimension nor nonconcentric shells are covered. A 1974 diffraction article was not accessible in complete form, so independent priority checking remains necessary.
title: A dimension-dependent phase law for critical Fourier zeros of spherical shells
